CONNECTIONS.DESCRIPTION: Connect Meta to bring its lead forms in. Google and TikTok come with the cost reports.

ERRORS.PERMISSION: Meta refused for lack of access, for the account that connected ({account}). Three things must be true for that page in Business Manager: the account needs full control of the page; the Raevo app must appear under Lead Access, CRMs; and that same account must be assigned under Lead Access, People, with permission to access leads — not only to manage who does.
ERRORS.TOKEN_EXPIRED: The Meta session expired. Disconnect and connect again.
ERRORS.RATE_LIMIT: Meta is throttling the requests. Try again in a few minutes.

CONNECTIONS.PAGE_LIMITED_HINT: Without full control of this page, Meta refuses to hand over its leads.
CONNECTIONS.PERMISSIONS_OK: Meta granted every permission the lead forms need.
CONNECTIONS.PERMISSIONS_MISSING: Meta did not grant: {scopes}. Add these permissions to the app, then disconnect and connect again leaving every box ticked.
